title: Six to Ten, and the Pairs That Shaped Each Other
label: ch:ru-count-ten
canDo: I can count aloud from one to ten in Russian and say why vosem ends like sem and devyat begins like desyat.

payoff.summary: Five more numbers with no new letter, two pairs shaped by standing next to each other, and the whole run of ten scored shuffled rather than recited.
